```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r load-data}
# -- Load the estimation dataset saved by ThesisManualH4_prep.Rmd -----------
est_data <- read.csv('./est_data.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf('Loaded %d observations\n', nrow(est_data)))
```

```{r regressions, results='asis'}
# -- Main regression results ---------------------------------------------------
# Three panels: (A) Full sample, (B) HBO only, (C) WO only.
# Within each panel: OLS and IV (2SLS) for Full, STEM, and Non-STEM.
# All models use aggregate share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg.
# Controls: age, age², education_years, hours_worked, hours², partner.
# Fixed effect: field. SEs clustered at field level.

# Control variables (inlined in each formula — feols doesn't expand formula objects)
ctrl <- "age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner"
fe <- "field + survey_year"

# --- Panel A: All onderwijssoort (pooled) ------------------------------------

a_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
a_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
a_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ stem)
a_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ stem)
a_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ !stem)
a_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = est_data, cluster = ~ field,
                      subset = ~ !stem)

# First-stage F-stats (Panel A)
fs_a_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = est_data, cluster = ~ field)
fs_a_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = est_data, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_a_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = est_data, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_a_full  <- round(wald(fs_a_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_a_stem  <- round(wald(fs_a_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_a_nstem <- round(wald(fs_a_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel A: All Education Levels}\

')

etable(a_ols_full, a_iv_full, a_ols_stem, a_iv_stem, a_ols_nstem, a_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg = 'Intl. Share'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_a_full, f_a_full, f_a_stem, f_a_stem, f_a_nstem, f_a_nstem)))

# --- Panel B: HBO only -------------------------------------------------------

hbo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort == 'Hoger beroepsonderwijs')

b_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
b_iv_full   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
b_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
b_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
b_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
b_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income ~ age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field |
                       share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg,
                      data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_b_full <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = hbo, cluster = ~ field)
fs_b_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_b_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                     data = hbo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel B: HBO (Higher Professional Education)}\

')

etable(b_ols_full, b_iv_full, b_ols_stem, b_iv_stem, b_ols_nstem, b_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,

       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_b_full, f_b_full, f_b_stem, f_b_stem, f_b_nstem, f_b_nstem)))

# --- Panel C: WO only --------------------------------------------------------

wo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort == 'Wetenschappelijk onderwijs')

c_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                      data = wo, cluster = ~ field)

fs_c_stem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,
                    data = wo, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_c_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg ~ Z_visa_field_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field,

f_c_stem  <- round(wald(fs_c_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\\textbf{Panel C: WO (Research University)}\

etable(c_ols_full, c_iv_full, c_ols_stem, c_iv_stem, c_ols_nstem, c_iv_nstem,

hbo_wo <- est_data %>% filter(onderwijssoort %in% c("Hoger beroepsonderwijs", "Wetenschappelijk onderwijs"))

d_ols_full  <- feols(log_income ~ share_int_agg + age + age_sq + education_years + hours_worked + hours_sq + partner | field + onderwijssoort,
```

```{r regressions-z, results='asis'}
# -- Standardized regressions ---------------------------------------------------
# Same 4 panels as above but with z-score standardized continuous variables
# so coefficients represent the effect of a one-SD change.

est_data_z <- est_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(share_int_agg, age, education_years, hours_worked,
                   log_income, Z_visa_field_agg),
                ~ ( . - mean(., na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
                .names = "{.col}_z")) %>%
  mutate(age_sq_z = age_z^2,
         hours_sq_z = hours_worked_z^2)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Standardized Regressions}\\n\n')
cat('All continuous variables normalized to z-scores (mean 0, SD 1).\n\n')

# --- Panel A: All onderwijssoort (pooled) ------------------------------------

az_ols_full  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
az_iv_full   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
az_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
az_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
az_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
az_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_az_full <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_az_stem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field,
                    data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_az_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                       education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                       partner | field,
                     data = est_data_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_az_full  <- round(wald(fs_az_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_az_stem  <- round(wald(fs_az_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_az_nstem <- round(wald(fs_az_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel A: All Education Levels (Standardized)}\\n\n')

etable(az_ols_full, az_iv_full, az_ols_stem, az_iv_stem, az_ols_nstem, az_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg_z = 'Intl. Share (z)', Z_visa_field_agg_z = 'Visa Instr. (z)'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_az_full, f_az_full, f_az_stem, f_az_stem,
                            f_az_nstem, f_az_nstem)))

# --- Panel B: HBO only -------------------------------------------------------

bz_ols_full  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +

                            f_cz_nstem, f_cz_nstem)))

# --- Panel D: HBO + WO pooled -------------------------------------------------

hbo_wo_z <- est_data_z %>% filter(onderwijssoort %in% c("Hoger beroepsonderwijs", "Wetenschappelijk onderwijs"))

dz_ols_full  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field)
dz_iv_full   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field)
dz_ols_stem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
dz_iv_stem   <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
dz_ols_nstem <- feols(log_income_z ~ share_int_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                        education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                        partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)
dz_iv_nstem  <- feols(log_income_z ~ age_z + age_sq_z + education_years_z +
                        hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z + partner | field + onderwijssoort |
                        share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z,
                      data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

fs_dz_full <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                    data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field)
fs_dz_stem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                      education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                      partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                    data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ stem)
fs_dz_nstem <- feols(share_int_agg_z ~ Z_visa_field_agg_z + age_z + age_sq_z +
                       education_years_z + hours_worked_z + hours_sq_z +
                       partner | field + onderwijssoort,
                     data = hbo_wo_z, cluster = ~ field, subset = ~ !stem)

f_dz_full  <- round(wald(fs_dz_full,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_dz_stem  <- round(wald(fs_dz_stem,  'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)
f_dz_nstem <- round(wald(fs_dz_nstem, 'Z_visa_field_agg_z', print = FALSE)$stat, 1)

cat('\n\n\\textbf{Panel D: HBO + WO (Standardized)}\\n\n')

etable(dz_ols_full, dz_iv_full, dz_ols_stem, dz_iv_stem, dz_ols_nstem, dz_iv_nstem,
       se.below = TRUE,
       dict = c(share_int_agg_z = 'Intl. Share (z)', Z_visa_field_agg_z = 'Visa Instr. (z)'),
       digits = 3, digits.stats = 3,
       fitstat = c('n', 'r2'),
       headers = c('Full', '', 'STEM', '', 'Non-STEM', ''),
       extralines = list('F-stat (1st stage)' =
                          c(f_dz_full, f_dz_full, f_dz_stem, f_dz_stem,
                            f_dz_nstem, f_dz_nstem)))
```
